newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-LEHMAN, COUPLES, LOVE AND MICKELSON WIN IN MATCH PLAY.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-LEHMAN, COUPLES, LOVE AND MICKELSON WIN IN MATCH PLAY.

text.p: Tom Lehman, Fred Couples, Phil Mickelson and Davis Love III won first round matches Monday to advance to the semifinals of the United States Championship of golf's match play tournament.
Love beat Corey Pavin 5-3, Mickelson beat Mark O'meara 3-2, Couples beat Steve Stricker 2-1 and Lehman beat defending U.S. champion Scott Hocy 2-1.
The four losers on Monday won $20,000 each. The winner's purse is $200,000 and the runner up will get $150,000.
